title.suggested: London Paper Doubts Allen-Goss Fight Will Happen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a London Sporting and Dramatic News item saying Allen had covered Joe Goss's $500 deposit for a championship match, and predicting the fight would never come off.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, June 10, 1876; reprinted from the London Sporting and Dramatic News, May 27

facts.fact: Allen covered the $500 Joe Goss deposited with Eph. Holland of Cincinnati to make a match for the American championship and a purse of $1,000 to $5,000

notes: Current summary wrongly says Goss deposited the money to arrange the match as new news; it is a secondhand London report that Allen had covered it. Fact confidence medium (secondhand via Sporting Life).
